meaning.en: to be afraid / to be extremely frightened

equivalent.de: Angst haben; Todesangst haben, sich zu Tode erschrecken

intensity.en: moderate (scared) · extreme (scared to death / scared stiff)
intensity.tr: orta (scared) · aşırı (scared to death / scared stiff)

usage.en: scared of + noun/V-ing · scared to + verb · scared (that) + clause · scary = frightening. "afraid" is more neutral/formal and cannot stand before a noun (✗ an afraid child → a scared child). "I'm afraid…" = "unfortunately…".
usage.tr: scared of + isim/V-ing · scared to + fiil · scared (that) + cümle · scary = korkutucu. "afraid" daha nötr/resmîdir ve isimden önce gelmez (✗ an afraid child → a scared child). "I'm afraid…" = "maalesef…".

sentences.en: I'm [scared of] messing this up.
sentences.de: Ich habe Angst, das zu vermasseln.

sentences.en: I was [scared to death] when the car started skidding.
sentences.de: Ich hatte Todesangst, als das Auto ins Schleudern kam.

meaning.en: to be filled with terror; to freeze with fear
meaning.de: von panischer Angst erfüllt sein; vor Angst erstarren

equivalent.tr: dehşete düşmek, ödü patlamak, korkudan taş kesilmek
equivalent.de: panische Angst haben, vor Angst wie gelähmt sein

usage.en: terrified/petrified of sth/V-ing · terrified (that) … · terrifying. Intensified with absolutely.
usage.tr: terrified/petrified of sth/V-ing · terrified (that) … · terrifying = dehşet verici. absolutely ile güçlendirilir.

sentences.en: I'm [terrified of] flying.
sentences.de: Ich habe panische Angst vorm Fliegen.

sentences.en: I was absolutely [petrified] — I couldn't even move.
sentences.de: Ich war wie gelähmt vor Angst – ich konnte mich nicht einmal bewegen.

meaning.en: to lose control and overreact (from fear, panic, anger or shock)
meaning.tr: (korku, panik, öfke ya da şaşkınlıkla) kontrolünü kaybedip aşırı tepki vermek
meaning.de: die Kontrolle verlieren und überreagieren (vor Angst, Panik, Wut oder Schock)

equivalent.tr: paniklemek, kafayı yemek, çıldırmak, dehşete düşmek

literal.en: freak = something abnormal; out = out of control
literal.tr: freak = ucube, anormal şey; out = kontrolün dışına

usage.en: freak out (about/over sth) → intransitive, the one reacting. freak sb out → transitive, the one who scares/unsettles. be freaked out (by sth) → state. make sb freak out → to cause someone to react.
usage.tr: freak out (about/over sth) → geçişsiz, tepkiyi veren. freak sb out → geçişli, tedirgin eden/korkutan. be freaked out (by sth) → hâl. make sb freak out → birinin tepki vermesine yol açmak.

collocations.en: totally freak out · Don't freak out, but… · freaking out about
collocations.tr: totally freak out · Don't freak out, but… · freaking out about

sentences.en: I [freaked out] when I couldn't find my passport.
sentences.de: Ich bin durchgedreht, als ich meinen Pass nicht finden konnte.

sentences.en: Don't [freak out], but I kind of scratched your car.
sentences.tr: Sakin ol ama arabanı biraz çizdim galiba.
sentences.de: Flipp nicht aus, aber ich habe dein Auto ein bisschen zerkratzt.

sentences.en: That guy on the bus was really [freaking me out].
sentences.tr: Otobüsteki o adam beni cidden tedirgin ediyordu.
sentences.de: Der Typ im Bus war mir richtig unheimlich.

meaning.en: to be seized by panic / to have a panic attack
meaning.de: in Panik geraten / eine Panikattacke haben

equivalent.de: in Panik geraten; eine Panikattacke haben

usage.en: panic (about/over sth) — spelling: panicked, panicking · Don't panic. · in a panic · have a panic attack (medical; also as everyday exaggeration)
usage.tr: panic (about/over sth) — yazım: panicked, panicking · Don't panic. · in a panic · have a panic attack (tıbbi; gündelik dilde abartı olarak da)

sentences.en: I [panicked] and said yes without thinking.
sentences.de: Ich bin in Panik geraten und habe ohne nachzudenken Ja gesagt.

sentences.en: I [had a panic attack] on the train this morning.
sentences.tr: Bu sabah trende panik atak geçirdim.
sentences.de: Ich hatte heute Morgen im Zug eine Panikattacke.

meaning.en: to get scared and back out at the last moment
meaning.de: Angst bekommen und im letzten Moment zurückziehen

equivalent.tr: tırsmak, son anda cayıp kaçmak, yemedi

literal.en: chicken = a coward; out = out of the thing
literal.tr: chicken = tavuk (korkak); out = dışarı, işin dışına

usage.en: chicken out (of sth / of V-ing). "Don't be (a) chicken." get cold feet is more neutral; chicken out is mildly mocking.
usage.tr: chicken out (of sth / of V-ing). "Don't be (a) chicken." get cold feet daha nötr; chicken out hafif alaycı.

sentences.en: I was going to tell him how I feel, but I [chickened out].
sentences.de: Ich wollte ihm sagen, was ich fühle, aber ich habe gekniffen.

sentences.en: She [chickened out] of the bungee jump at the last second.
sentences.de: Sie hat beim Bungeesprung in letzter Sekunde einen Rückzieher gemacht.

expressions.expr: be creeped out / give someone the creeps

meaning.en: to be unsettled by something eerie or unpleasant
meaning.tr: tekinsiz, ürpertici bir şeyden rahatsız olmak
meaning.de: von etwas Unheimlichem oder Unangenehmem beunruhigt sein

equivalent.de: sich gruseln; jemandem unheimlich sein, jemandem eine Gänsehaut machen

usage.en: be creeped out (by sth) · creep sb out · give sb the creeps · creepy = eerie, unsettling · a creep = an unpleasant, sleazy person
usage.tr: be creeped out (by sth) · creep sb out · give sb the creeps · creepy = ürkütücü, tekinsiz · a creep = sapık/itici tip

sentences.en: That abandoned house [gives me the creeps].
sentences.tr: O terk edilmiş ev tüylerimi ürpertiyor.
sentences.de: Dieses verlassene Haus ist mir unheimlich.

sentences.en: I was [creeped out] by the way he kept staring.
sentences.tr: Sürekli dik dik bakmasından tedirgin oldum.
sentences.de: Es hat mich gegruselt, wie er mich ständig angestarrt hat.

meaning.en: to lack confidence; to feel inadequate or not good enough
meaning.de: wenig Selbstvertrauen haben; sich unzulänglich fühlen

equivalent.tr: kendine güvenmemek, kompleks duymak, güvensiz hissetmek

usage.en: be/feel insecure (about sth) · insecurity/insecurities (noun) · "He's very insecure." (personality)
usage.tr: be/feel insecure (about sth) · insecurity/insecurities (isim) · "He's very insecure." (kişilik)

note.en: insecure is about a person's lack of confidence. For "a place that isn't safe" say unsafe / not safe.
note.tr: insecure kişinin özgüvensizliğidir. "Güvenli olmayan yer" = unsafe / not safe.

sentences.en: I [feel insecure about] my body sometimes.
sentences.tr: Bazen bedenim konusunda kendimi güvensiz hissediyorum.
sentences.de: Manchmal bin ich unsicher wegen meines Körpers.

sentences.en: He's pretty [insecure] — that's why he's always putting people down.
sentences.tr: Aslında özgüvensiz, o yüzden hep başkalarını küçümsüyor.
sentences.de: Er ist ziemlich unsicher – deshalb macht er andere ständig schlecht.

meaning.en: to still be upset after a frightening or sad event
meaning.tr: korkutucu/üzücü bir olaydan sonra hâlâ sarsılmış olmak
meaning.de: nach einem erschreckenden oder traurigen Ereignis noch aufgewühlt sein

variety.en: AmE + BrE ("shaken up" is more common in AmE)
variety.tr: AmE + BrE ("shaken up" AmE'de daha sık)

usage.en: be/feel/look (pretty/a bit) shaken (up) (by sth) · sth shakes sb (up)
usage.tr: be/feel/look (pretty/a bit) shaken (up) (by sth) · sth shakes sb (up)

sentences.en: She wasn't hurt in the accident, but she was pretty [shaken up].
sentences.de: Sie wurde bei dem Unfall nicht verletzt, war aber ziemlich mitgenommen.

sentences.en: I'm still a bit [shaken], to be honest.
sentences.de: Ich bin ehrlich gesagt immer noch etwas durcheinander.

meaning.en: to be suspicious or worried without good reason, or far too much
meaning.tr: yersiz ya da abartılı biçimde kuşkulanmak/endişelenmek
meaning.de: ohne guten Grund oder viel zu sehr misstrauisch oder besorgt sein

equivalent.tr: paranoya yapmak, evham yapmak, pireyi deve yapmak
equivalent.de: paranoid sein, sich verrückt machen, Gespenster sehen

register.en: informal (exaggerated use, independent of the medical meaning)

usage.en: be/get paranoid (about sth) · "You're being paranoid." · "Maybe I'm just being paranoid, but…"
usage.tr: be/get paranoid (about sth) · "You're being paranoid." · "Maybe I'm just being paranoid, but…"

sentences.en: I'm [paranoid about] leaving the stove on.
sentences.tr: Ocağı açık bıraktım mı diye evham yapıyorum.
sentences.de: Ich habe ständig Angst, den Herd angelassen zu haben.

sentences.en: You're being [paranoid] — nobody's talking about you.
sentences.tr: Paranoya yapıyorsun, kimse senin hakkında konuşmuyor.
sentences.de: Du siehst Gespenster – niemand redet über dich.

expressions.expr: scare the hell out of someone

equivalent.de: jemanden zu Tode erschrecken, jemandem einen Riesenschreck einjagen

literal.en: to frighten the hell out of someone; out of = from inside to outside
literal.tr: birinin içindeki cehennemi korkutup çıkarmak; out of = içinden dışarı

usage.en: scare the hell / the life / (vulgar) the crap out of sb. Milder: "You scared me!" · make sb jump = to startle.
usage.tr: scare the hell / the life / (kaba) the crap out of sb. Hafifi: "You scared me!" · make sb jump = irkiltmek.

sentences.en: Don't sneak up on me like that — you [scared the hell out of me]!
sentences.de: Schleich dich nicht so an – du hast mich zu Tode erschreckt!

sentences.en: That movie [scared the crap out of me].
sentences.de: Der Film hat mir eine Heidenangst eingejagt.
